entries.summary: Teleporting while walking somewhere now always stops that walk. Before, a walk along roads that was still looking up its path could start anyway after the teleport and head back toward the old spot.

Moving the joystick now puts you in control right away. It ends any walk, route, roam, or planting, even a paused one, and stops following a group leader, so you move from where you are instead of having to stop things first.
